text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That day, the members were summoned. 
Currently, several dozen Umamusume are 
participating in Project L'Arc.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, only four can challenge the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe— To truly win, one 
must be prepared to select the Umamusume 
capable of victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing the news, Orfevre called it "only 
natural." Winning the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe is the dream of everyone involved 
in the project—and she had helped them 
realize that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we want to send <chrname> to the world's 
greatest stage, we must build her strength 
to a level undeniable to all—a back 
capable of carrying everyone's dreams.
